faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BEML Chief General Manager – HR recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the BEML Chief General Manager – HR position is 30th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Personnel Management, HR Management, Industrial Relations, or an MBA in HR. A Law degree is considered an added advantage.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed for the Chief General Manager – HR role?
faq.answer: You need to have 21 years of post-qualification experience in HR functions, preferably in a large industrial setting, to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Chief General Manager – HR post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief General Manager – HR post is 51 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Chief General Manager – HR position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Chief General Manager – HR post ranges from Rs.1,20,000 to Rs.2,80,000 per month, along with various allowances and perquisites.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the BEML Chief General Manager – HR recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online only through the career page on the official BEML website. Ensure all details are filled correctly and required documents are uploaded.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs.500/- for candidates belonging to the General, EWS, and OBC categories. SC/ST/PwD candidates are usually exempted, but please check the official notification for confirmation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Chief General Manager – HR role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Assessment (Through Video Conference), followed by a Pre-employment medical examination and Original document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any part of India apply?
faq.answer: Yes, this recruitment is open to eligible candidates from Across India. The job location is primarily Bangalore.
